news.title: 加息大消息！美联储，突传重磅！
news.detail: 沃什正面临重大挑战。 目前，规模达31万亿美元的美债市场已率先定价美联储加息预期，债券交易员押注，美联储最快可能在今年10月加息25个基点。

insight.what: 美联储可能加息或维持鹰派立场
insight.assets: 📉 美股大盘 承压；📈 美元指数 走强
insight.chain: 加息预期→风险资产（股票/加密货币）遭抛售→资金流入避险（美债/黄金）
insight.watch: 美联储官员讲话及FOMC（联邦公开市场委员会）会议纪要

news.title: Inflation data threatens to derail market comeback. How the S&P 500 may react
news.detail: Investors will be watching core inflation in May closely to see just how long higher prices from the U.S.-Iran war may last, according to JPMorgan.

insight.what: 通胀数据可能破坏美股反弹
insight.assets: 📉 标普500指数 承压；📈 美债收益率 上行
insight.chain: 通胀超预期→加息预期升温→成长股（科技/高估值）估值压缩→市场波动加剧
insight.watch: CPI（消费者物价指数）及PCE（个人消费支出）数据

news.title: SpaceX employee group creates low-fee wealth management option with Choreo for post-IPO
news.detail: The deal marks a bold experiment in the wealth management industry that could shift the balance of power from advisory firms to wealthy groups of investors.

insight.what: SpaceX员工获低费理财选项，为IPO做准备
insight.assets: 📈 私人公司股权（SpaceX） 利好；📉 传统投行/理财顾问 承压
insight.chain: 员工持股流动性提升→IPO估值预期上调→带动私人航天板块热度

news.detail: President Donald Trump has repeatedly said a deal with Tehran to reopen Hormuz is close, but such an agreement still has not materialized.

news.title: Upstart chipmakers keep challenging Nvidia. This time it's Microsoft-backed D-Matrix
news.detail: Nvidia challenger D-Matrix is entering full production of an AI chip it says is 10 times faster than a GPU and bypasses the memory shortage.

insight.what: 微软支持的D-Matrix挑战英伟达AI芯片
